description: This source file defines Orleans grain classes with dependency injection, including grains with injected services, service implementations, and associated interfaces. It illustrates usage of dependency injection, grain lifecycle management, and custom grain types within an Orleans project.

classes.name: DIGrainWithInjectedServices
classes.description: An Orleans grain demonstrating dependency injection of singleton and scoped services, fetching grain context information, and managing grain lifecycle.

classes.name: ExplicitlyRegisteredSimpleDIGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain with explicitly injected dependencies, returning stored values.

classes.name: InjectedService
classes.description: A service implementing IInjectedService, providing Ticks and instance value, facilitates logging on disposal.

classes.name: InjectedScopedService
classes.description: A scoped service implementing IInjectedScopedService, providing a unique instance value, with disposal logging.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation, captures original grain context.

methods.name: GetLongValue
methods.description: Returns the current UTC time in ticks via injected service.

methods.name: GetInjectedSingletonServiceValue
methods.description: Returns the singleton injected service instance value.

methods.name: GetInjectedScopedServiceValue
methods.description: Returns the scoped injected service instance value.

methods.name: GetGrainFactoryId
methods.description: Returns an identifier for the injected grain factory.

methods.name: AssertCanResolveSameServiceInstances
methods.description: Checks if services resolved from ServiceProvider are the same as injected instances.

methods.name: GetLongValue
methods.description: Returns a stored number indicating how many instances were released before activation.

methods.name: GetStringValue
methods.description: Returns a stored string value that was injected.

methods.name: GetTicks
methods.description: Provides current UTC ticks, part of IInjectedService implementation.

methods.name: GetInstanceValue
methods.description: Returns a GUID string unique to this service instance.

methods.name: InjectedService
methods.description: Implementation of IInjectedService, logs its disposal, provides timestamp and a GUID instance value.

methods.name: GetInstanceValue
methods.description: Returns a unique GUID string representing the service instance.

methods.name: InjectedScopedService
methods.description: Implementation of IInjectedScopedService, with an instance GUID, logs disposal.
